skills.description: Become proficient in the bounty hunting fundamentals. Increases Attack Power, Jump, and Skill.

skills.name: Blaster Barrage
skills.description: Fires a pair of shots straight ahead. Hold down the skill key for continuous fire. You can move left and right while attacking.

skills.name: Space Walk
skills.description: Use the arrow keys to tumble while jumping. Press jump and the arrow key again to tumble once more in the selected direction.

skills.name: Double Shot
skills.description: Fires two consecutive bullets at the enemy. The maximum range increases as the skill level increases.

skills.name: Dash
skills.description: Tap left or right twice to temporarily boost Speed and Jump. [Dash activation: ->-> or <-<- with the arrow keys.]

skills.name: Gun Mastery

skills.name: Cosmic Shield
skills.description: Permanently enhances STR, DEX, Max HP, and Max MP through physical training. Has a chance to trigger Knockback Resistance.

skills.name: Bounty Chaser
skills.description: Pull out all the stops to take down your target. Enhances your physical strength and increases your Attack Power.\nRequired Skill: Gun Mastery Lv. 5

skills.name: Stellar Impact
skills.description: Smashes a spacecraft into the ground, creating devastating shockwaves. The shockwaves penetrate multiple enemies and launch them into the air, making them vulnerable to later attacks.

skills.name: Starline Two
skills.description: Unleash beams of energy on multiple enemies. Has a chance to stun enemies.

skills.name: Vortex Cross
skills.description: Strike enemies as you warp past them.\r\nYou will move upwards  while pressing the Up arrow key.

skills.name: Clairvoyant
skills.description: Enhances vision to permanently determine weaknesses, and grants the ability to predict attacks.

skills.name: Blaster Overdrive
skills.description: Removes all safeties from your weapons, granting them ridiculous Critical Rate and Weapon ATT bonuses.

skills.name: Falling Stars

skills.name: Cosmic Upheaval
skills.description: Explode the ground beneath nearby enemies and draw them in.

skills.name: Giga Blaster
skills.description: Upgrades your arsenal to the biggest, baddest blasters in the universe. Increases the Critical Damage of your hits.

skills.name: Invincibility
skills.description: Hones your body to maximize your defensive capabilities. Increase your strength, resulting in greater damage.

skills.name: Jett Supreme Enhancement
skills.description: Maximize Attack Power by carefully controlling the power of the Core that flows inside you.

skills.name: Gravity Booster
skills.description: Increase your mass, stabilizing yourself and greatly increasing your Attack Power.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: Temporarily increases the stats of all party members.

skills.name: Starforce Salvo
skills.description: Fires a hail of energy bolts. Hold down the skill key to keep shooting. You can move left and right while attacking.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to Abnormal Status for 3 sec after use.

skills.name: Starfall
skills.description: Order your spaceship to attack multiple enemies at once.

skills.name: Singularity Shock

skills.name: Rising Cosmos

skills.name: Planet Buster

skills.name: Strikeforce Showdown

skills.name: Loaded Dice
skills.description: The next time you use Roll of the Dice, you get to throw an extra die and choose your desired number (via the number keys). Jobs without Roll of the Dice will be allowed to use the Roll of the Dice skill and choose their desired number.
skills.note: Shared pirate V skill (Loaded Dice).

skills.name: Roll of the Dice
skills.description: Test your luck! Roll dice to get a random Buff. Roll a 1 and you get nothing, but Roll of the Dice's cooldown will be reduced by 50%.
skills.note: V-matrix Roll of the Dice; Jett has no 1st-4th Roll of the Dice — this is its V-matrix version.

skills.description: A powerful singularity draws in enemies. Detonating the singularity inflicts significant damage across a wide area. Unaffected by attack reflection.
